text.tspan: - Version 2.0.0. Not yet verified in the game client: it passes a mocked-client test

svg.text: suite and boots cleanly in a simulated UI, but nobody has confirmed it in the real game.

text.tspan: - Bars turn in quarter turns only, and a turned icon's border, sweep and number stay

svg.text: upright. Unit frames do not turn.

text.tspan: - Glow, dim and red tint depend on what the game will tell an addon. In combat it

svg.text: may withhold those answers; the icon then stays plain. A cooldown it will not reveal shows no

text.tspan: - The IDs listed are rank 1 and only a fallback: at login the addon asks the game for

svg.text: the ID behind each spellbook name, so an icon follows the rank you know.

text.tspan: - Public API only. No protected calls, no combat automation, no combat log,

svg.text: nothing written outside its own saved settings.

text.tspan: - One generator produces all nine class HUDs from a single reference, with a

svg.text: mocked-client test suite, a Lua 5.1 limits check and a simulated-UI run on every build.
